tasks.title: Servo pulse: the MIN…MAX line
tasks.solution: The allocator outputs v = clamp(TRIM + u, −1, 1). output_limit_calc_single: µs = MIN + (v + 1)/2 · (MAX − MIN), then rounded with lroundf. Tolerance ±1 µs.

tasks.title: Servo pulse: CENT and reversal (1.17)
tasks.solution: Reversal first: w = −v. Then two lines through the center: w < 0 → MIN + (w + 1) · (CENT − MIN); w ≥ 0 → CENT + w · (MAX − CENT). Reversal mirrors the command, and the center stays put.

tasks.title: REV mask
tasks.solution: Bit n−1 is output n: mask = 2^(a−1) + 2^(b−1) + 2^(c−1). For example, outputs 2, 3, 5 → 2 + 4 + 16 = 22.

tasks.title: eRPM → RPM
tasks.solution: DShot::process_bdshot_telemetry (v1.18.0): erpm = value · 100, then esc_rpm = erpm / (DSHOT_MOT_POLn / 2), all in integers, so the fractional part is dropped. Pole pairs = poles / 2. In 1.16–1.17 the same formula used the shared MOT_POLE_COUNT.

tasks.title: How many servos go to MAIN
tasks.solution: 3–4 DShot motors fit only in the AUX1–4 group and take all of it; 5–6 motors also take AUX5–6. That leaves 4 or 2 FMU outputs for 50 Hz. The trigger takes one two-output group. For servos on the FMU that leaves 2 outputs (3–4 motors) or 0 (5–6 motors); the other servos go to MAIN.
